scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [06:05], the agent made a condescending remark ('Well, it's really not rocket science, Balthazar—if you plug a mesh pod into a surge extension lead behind a cast-iron radiator, what did you expect to happen?') instead of explaining radio interference respectfully.

grader.scenario: Wi-Fi mesh pods flashing amber and not linking to the main router in a three-storey townhouse
grader.notes: Strong technical troubleshooting call where Chloe verifies security early, shows warm empathy ([01:20]), paraphrases accurately ([01:33]), probes thoroughly into physical placement and router band-splitting, and achieves full live resolution (310 Mbps in the attic at [14:09]). However, she fails Professionalism (R) due to a buried condescending jab at [06:05] ('Well, it's really not rocket science, Balthazar...').

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: At [01:20], Chloe warmly validates Balthazar's frustration: 'I am so sorry you've spent your entire afternoon running up and down three flights of stairs, Balthazar—I completely understand how stressful that is with a big client presentation first thing tomorrow morning.'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Chloe retains every detail Balthazar shares—including pod serial endings 49B and 82C ([02:45]), the three-storey Victorian layout, and his 9:00 AM 3D CAD presentation ([14:20], [15:35])—without asking him to repeat information.

items.evidence: At [13:22]–[15:22], Balthazar confirms both mesh pods (49B and 82C) are solid white, runs a live speed test in the attic study reaching 310 Mbps download and 52 Mbps upload ([14:09]), and confirms the issue is completely resolved ([15:22]).
